- [ ] **APPROVED** — Security architecture approved to proceed
- [ ] **APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS** — Security architecture approved with specific conditions that must be resolved
- [ ] **DEFERRED** — Additional information or remediation required before decision
- [ ] **REJECTED** — Security architecture does not meet requirements or standards
